verdict.rationale: Raygun's 'AI Resolution' feature explicitly uses AI (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) to suggest root causes and fixes for errors, working from stack trace/class name/error data, and integrates with repos (GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab) for source context, matching the core of this story. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm the AI ingests breadcrumbs or correlates specific commits as part of its reasoning, and there's no independent/hands-on validation of the suggestion quality. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of breadcrumb/commit-level correlation feeding the AI analysis, and independent corroboration of real-world root-cause accuracy.
